<tool_call>

def platpos(fr):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b':
            b=n['boundary']; return (min(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b))
def timer(fr):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N': return n['pixels']
    return 0
def move_to(target):
    r,c=platpos(current_frame); tr,tc=target; seq=[]
    while r<tr: seq.append('DOWN'); r+=4
    while r>tr: seq.append('UP'); r-=4
    while c<tc: seq.append('RIGHT'); c+=4
    while c>tc: seq.append('LEFT'); c-=4
    return seq
# ordered sweep: magenta-aligned mid cols first
order=[(16,28),(16,36),(20,28),(20,36),(24,28),(24,36),(28,28),(28,36),(32,28),(32,36),(36,28),(36,36),(40,28),(40,36),
       (16,24),(16,40),(20,24),(20,40),(24,24),(24,40),(28,24),(28,40),(32,24),(32,40),(36,24),(36,40),(40,24),(40,40),
       (24,8),(24,4),(28,8),(28,4),(32,8),(32,4),(36,8),(36,4),(40,8),(40,4)]
for tgt in order:
    seq=move_to(tgt)
    if not seq: 
        print('already at',tgt); continue
    res=action(seq)
    lr=last_action_result
    print('->',tgt,'pos',platpos(current_frame),'timer',timer(current_frame),'done',lr.get('done'),'lvl',lr.get('level_completed'),'go',lr.get('game_over'))
    if lr.get('done') or lr.get('level_completed') or lr.get('game_over') or lr.get('run_complete'):
        print('STOP'); break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
